text:
alex: FYI customer AcmeApps (acct_id: acct_9xA2) reported promo code ACME-REDWOOD-TRIAL applied to Dedicated SKU instead of Hosted credits. Customer noticed credits show on their Dedicated allocation and their Hosted usage is billing normally. Ticket CS-1129 created.
jessica_billing: can you paste the promo redemption response from the billing API + account id? I'll look up the allocation record.
alex: pasted below — response from /v1/promos/redeem (redacted):
```
{
  "promo_code": "ACME-REDWOOD-TRIAL",
  "account": "acct_9xA2",
  "applied_to": "dedicated-monthly-16gpu",
  "amount_usd": 1200,
  "redeemed_at": "2026-03-12T15:22:09Z",
  "status": "applied"
}
```
matt_cs: oh that explains the mismatch. Customer expected 12 months of Hosted credits (hosted-hourly/hosted-monthly SKU) but promo was configured to target dedicated SKUs. Did they enter a product-specific promo?
jessica_billing: looks like the promo entry in admin console was scoped to product_id=dedi_pool_16 (weird). I can manually reverse and reapply to hosted if finance is OK with manual adjustment. How much is the remaining balance?
leo_eng: quick check — the Dedicated pool hasn't actually consumed the credit yet, only allocation metadata exists. No runtime usage charged against it. So safe to move.
alex: customer says they haven't used the dedicated pool. They need hosted credits applied today so their staging tests can run.
jessica_billing: steps I'll do: 1) create reversal txn for $1200 (reverses promo allocation) 2) reissue promo redemption scoped to hosted-credit SKU (hosted-monthly-credits) 3) confirm on account and send customer confirmation. Requires finance approval for manual reversals > $1k. Tagging finance.
matt_cs: include a note in the customer's org record so audit trail is clear (CS-1129).
jessica_billing: pinging finance: @finance_team can someone approve manual reversal of $1200 for acct_9xA2?
billing-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: Manual reversal request submitted. Request ID: br_20260312_558. Amount: $1200. Approver: finance_team. ETA: 4h.
jessica_billing: finance approved via email (thread linked). Proceeding now. Reversal in progress, then reapply.
billing-bot: TRANSACTION: reversal_created id=txn_rev_77 amount_usd=1200 account=acct_9xA2 created_at=2026-03-12T16:01:02Z
jessica_billing: done. Now redeeming ACME-REDWOOD-TRIAL to hosted credits (hosted-monthly-credits). Redeem API call returned success: applied_to=hosted-monthly-credits amount_usd=1200.
leo_eng: I verified the account metadata — hosted credits now show under acct_9xA2 and the dedicated allocation cleared.
matt_cs: I'll update CS-1129 with the reversal txn id txn_rev_77 and new promo redemption id redeem_903. Also emailing the customer with steps and confirmation.
alex: customer confirmation sent — they replied :relieved: saying staging runs green. Thanks team.
jessica_billing: leaving a follow-up action: change promo ACME-REDWOOD-TRIAL rule in admin console to explicitly target hosted SKUs only to prevent repeats. Filed internal request: PLAT-4456.
matt_cs: closing CS-1129 after 24h if no regressions.
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
